message.content:
Here’s a classic set of ingredients you’ll find on most chocolate‑cake recipes (for about an 8 × 8 in. pan or two 9 × 5 in. loaf pans):

| Ingredient | Typical Amount |
|------------|----------------|
| All‑purpose flour | 1 ¾ cups (220 g) – sifted |
| Granulated sugar | 2 cups (400 g) |
| Unsweetened cocoa powder | ¾ cup (75 g) – unsweetened and finely ground |
| Baking soda | 1 tsp (≈ 5 g) |
| Baking powder | ½ tsp (≈ 2 g) |
| Salt | ¼ tsp (≈ 1 g) |
| Eggs | 2 large (room temp.) |
| Whole milk | 1 cup (240 ml) – at room temp. |
| Vegetable oil (or melted butter) | ⅔ cup (150 ml) |
| Vanilla extract | 2 tsp (10 mL) |
| Boiling water (optional, for richer flavor) | 1 cup (240 ml) |

**Optional extras**

* **Buttermilk** instead of regular milk (adds tanginess).  
* **Coffee** (a tablespoon brewed strong) enhances chocolate depth.  
* **Chocolate chips / chunks** folded into batter before baking.  

Feel free to tweak quantities based on your preferred texture—more flour gives a denser crumb; more liquid yields a moister one. Happy baking!
